d:
Another translation project completed! This one hadn’t been translated since 2018 — such a long time ago!. Interestingly, this time I had to put in a bit more effort because I needed to clean up some text boxes and redraw a few scenes. I hope the changes aren’t too obvious; I did my best, but I’m not a professional artist. As always, I’d love to get your feedback on the translation. Any tips or advice to help me improve my future translation work would be greatly appreciated.

Link to the original work https://e-hentai.org/g/1290753/bc006cfaf3/ Uploaded by *dawaihih*
